title: Doolittle sent to investigate Swedish ghost rockets

tellings.quote: We do know for a fact that Eisenhower sent General James Doolittle to investigate Swedish ghost rockets.

plain: Dwight D. Eisenhower, the American general who later became president, sent General James Doolittle to look into the Swedish ghost rockets. These were mysterious rocket-like objects reported over Sweden and Finland in 1946. Michels says "we do know for a fact" that this happened, telling it himself in his 2023 episode with David Grusch.
